# Original COLR foreground fixture

`colr-foreground.ttf` is an original 2026 Jiaqi (0x7c13) Liu test fixture under the repository MIT license. It contains no platform or third-party font bytes.

Its existing tiny mock outlines have 1000 units/em, 600 advance, and a 500 by 700 rectangle. COLRv0 glyph 1 paints outline glyph 2 with palette index FFFF; CPAL entry 0 remains opaque red. A new format12 cmap maps only U+0041 to glyph 1. Tests register the family as Mock explicitly; the fixture intentionally has no name table. Like the original parser mocks, table checksums are zero, and it is not a platform-installation fixture.

The usvg regression verifies that all pre-existing table payloads match the original mock exactly, except the explicit FFFF palette field. The generator is retained in the local evidence directory. This is a fixed input, not an expected image generated by the renderer.
